Agent Name: **Planner**  
Step Number: **1**  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made an error in interpreting the input parameters, specifically the mass of the baseball. The task clearly provides a mass of 0.15 kg, but the Planner incorrectly uses 0.1125 kg in their calculation. This deviation leads to an incorrect momentum calculation of \( p = m \times v = 0.1125 \, \text{kg} \times 40 \, \text{m/s} = 4.5 \, \text{kg} \times \text{m/s} \), which does not match the correct answer of \( p = 0.15 \, \text{kg} \times 40 \, \text{m/s} = 6.0 \, \text{kg} \times \text{m/s}. \) 

This error fits with "Error Signatures" and "Error Context Analysis" patterns discussed in Example 1, as the root cause lies in a **misinterpretation of input parameters** (the mass value) and **premature task completion** without cross-verifying the input values or calculated results.
